text: Which art direction should become the single production direction? The review recommends voxel-toy characters (Riff roster) with toon+rim+outline world shading and a saturated blue/indigo shell with orange Play and white Lilita One text with a navy stroke. This replaces the cream shell palette chosen in BRL-0112/BRL-0114.
suggestions: Voxel-toy roster + saturated blue shell (review recommendation)
Voxel-toy roster + keep the cream/teal/orange shell
